name: Bracken
greeting: A young Hearthscale braces his plated forelegs against a strap caught in the roadside roots. A traveling harness lies beside him, its owner's name worn away. Tor calls these warm-stone scavengers good company when they choose it.
lines: Kael: Easy. Pulling only tightens it. I'll stay here a moment.
He watches the open hand, then lets the strap slacken. This is an ordinary frightened animal, not the thing haunting Toma's fold.

actions.label: Kneel nearby and let him settle.

variants.greeting: Bracken lifts his head at Kael's step.
The Hearthscale has stayed on Greyfen's sun-warmed verge. There is water here, and no strap to pull him back.
lines: Kael: I wasn't ready to promise you a road. I haven't forgotten you.
Bracken stands, waiting to see whether this visit will be different.

variants.greeting: The loose strap drops into the grass. The small plated creature could leave, but takes a careful step toward Kael instead.
lines: Kael: Bracken. A better name than whatever they scratched off that harness.
Kael: The road isn't kind. Neither is being left on it. You needn't decide as quickly as I do.

actions.label: You can make a home with me.
Stay safe in Greyfen for now. I'll remember where you are.

variants.greeting: His breathing slows. The harness strap, not his leg, is caught beneath a root.
lines: Kael: Just the buckle. Keep still. Then the choice is yours.
